purpose: Smaller familiarity-focused batch after targeted batch 08; prioritize ordinary objects, food, animals, clothing and descriptive adjectives.
method: Exclude exact previously recorded Georgian spellings from all content/dictionaries/*.json and docs/VOCABULARY*.json, including all 100 batch-08 words and the additional literal exclusion უფარო. Check selected senses individually against sources. Newer loanwords checked against language references rather than accepted on colloquial frequency alone.
limitations: Owner review complete: 18 approved and seven rejected. No boards generated or repetition change measured. No active dictionary, policy, pack or save changes.
sourceAttribution: Georgian explanatory dictionary/Linguistic Technologies Group; Dictionary.ge; University of Georgia synonym dictionary; NPLG material-culture dictionary; Wiktionary and Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0 for adapted entries). Brief adapted English glosses only. Individual source URLs, available revisions and hashes retained.
